prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in League City, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1031; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was stopped at a light on the main road in League City, near the shopping center entrance.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car behind me didn't stop in time. I felt a hard jolt from behind, and my head snapped forward and back.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, the whole time.

Q: Did you have any immediate symptoms?

A: Not right away. I got out, talked to the other driver, and thought I was fine. By that evening my neck was stiff and sore, and it's gotten worse since.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Are you still having pain or limited movement?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the left hurts, and I get headaches toward the end of the day. I've missed a few shifts at work because of it.

Q: Did you have any neck problems before this collision?

A: No, not that I can recall. My neck has never bothered me like this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I'm still in treatment and I'll send you the physical therapy records when I get them.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
